committed_metric_report.note: All three branches are recomputed by the runner with the frozen M3 branch_metrics function; the two frozen branches must reproduce the Phase 9 baseline above.

determinism_requirement.expectation: run_A and run_B translations byte-identical for all 20 intents
determinism_requirement.if_violated: Report as a primary finding. Non-determinism at temperature 0 / seed 42 would undermine the reproducibility assumption of the whole runtime. The gate is still evaluated on run_A.

interpretation_of_failure: A FAIL does not authorise a quick fix. It means the VI runtime branch is not accepted as fidelity-preserving, and any response is a separately scoped decision recorded in a new milestone.
naming_note: Phase 9 already uses m1/m2/m3 for the multilingual BENCHMARK. This milestone is Multilingual Runtime V1 M2 and uses the distinct prefix multilingual_runtime_v1_m2 in all script, report and artifact names to avoid collision with the frozen Phase 9 artifacts.
objective: Measure whether the shipped runtime machine translator preserves the retrieval fidelity that Phase 9 measured on human-approved literal English. Phase 9 results were obtained with human-reviewed literal_en and do NOT automatically transfer to the runtime.
output_manifest_requirement: m2_manifest.json records SHA-256 of the pre-registration, every frozen input, every runtime source and every output artifact.

evaluation_rule.criterion_a: mit60001-q-008 has the maximum rank_delta_machine_minus_frozen among the 20 intents (ties count as satisfied)
evaluation_rule.criterion_b: mit60001-q-008 has the minimum top_3_overlap among the 20 intents (ties count as satisfied)

preregistered_predictions.statement: q-008 will again be the most translation-sensitive intent, operationalised as: it ranks worst on at least one of (a) largest first-relevant-rank degradation vs frozen literal_en, (b) lowest Top-3 overlap vs frozen literal_en.

preregistration_revision_note: Revision 2 hardens the protocol BEFORE execution: runtime source hashes are verified by the runner, both frozen baselines are stated in full, the three-branch metric table is committed, P1 is given a machine-checkable rule, and an output manifest is required. No M2 result has been produced or observed at revision 2.

conditions_all_must_hold.statement: semantic_drift_count == 0 under the M1 adjudication rubric
Recall@3 of machine_literal_en must not fall more than 0.05 below frozen literal_en

prohibited_after_seeing_results: modifying the translation prompt, translator parameters or retriever
editing any frozen Phase 9 artifact or Ground Truth
re-running with different parameters and reporting the better run
redefining the gate or the prediction

runtime_under_test.source_hash_normalisation: CRLF collapsed to LF before hashing

secondary_observations_not_gates: MRR, Recall@1, Recall@5, Full Evidence@3 for all three branches
per-intent first relevant rank delta and Top-3 overlap
exact string controls mit60001-q-003 and mit60001-q-022
translator prompt_eval_count / eval_count and whether any intent reached the num_predict=128 cap
